title: Derived pullback and derived tensor preserve D_QCoh
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. The derived pullback $Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] sends $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ into $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and for objects $K,L$ of $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ the derived tensor product $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L$ lies in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$.

source.place: Lemma 36.3.8 (perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-pullback, Tag 08DW) part (1) and Lemma 36.3.9 (perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-tensor-product, Tag 08DX) part (1)

proof.text: Let $E$ be an object of $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$. Quasi-coherence of the cohomology sheaves of $Lf^*E$ is local on $X$, so it suffices to treat affine opens $U=\operatorname{Spec}(B)\subseteq X$ with $f(U)\subseteq V=\operatorname{Spec}(A)\subseteq Y$ affine open; these cover $X$. By clause (1) of [lem-pc-affine-derived-pullback-tensor-tilde], $(Lf^*E)|_U\cong L(f|_U)^*(E|_V)$. As $E|_V$ lies in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_V)$, the affine derived equivalence [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] gives $E|_V\cong\widetilde{M^\bullet}$ for a complex $M^\bullet$ of $A$-modules. By clause (2) of [lem-pc-affine-derived-pullback-tensor-tilde], $L(f|_U)^*\widetilde{M^\bullet}\cong\widetilde{M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B}$, which lies in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_U)$ because the functor of [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] (for $B$) lands there. Hence $Lf^*E$ has quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves.

Let $K,L$ be objects of $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$. Quasi-coherence of the cohomology sheaves is local on $X$, so it suffices to treat an affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}(A)\subseteq X$. By clause (1) of [lem-pc-affine-derived-pullback-tensor-tilde], $(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L)|_U\cong K|_U\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_U}L|_U$. By [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence], $K|_U\cong\widetilde{M^\bullet}$ and $L|_U\cong\widetilde{N^\bullet}$ for complexes of $A$-modules $M^\bullet,N^\bullet$. By clause (3) of [lem-pc-affine-derived-pullback-tensor-tilde], $\widetilde{M^\bullet}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_U}\widetilde{N^\bullet}\cong\widetilde{M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}N^\bullet}$, which lies in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_U)$ by [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence]. Since such $U$ cover $X$, $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L$ is in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$.
